priorStories.headline: Orange County fire forces 16,000 to evacuate
priorStories.body:
The Norte Fire spread to 570 acres near San Clemente and San Juan Capistrano and was 0% contained as of 7:28 p.m. Pacific time Friday.

At least six homes burned, about 16,000 residents were ordered to evacuate and two firefighters were hospitalized with heat-related injuries. Evacuation orders covered five zones.

priorStories.headline: Aerial attacks disrupt power and Russian flights
priorStories.body:
Russian attacks struck nine Ukrainian regions overnight, wounding at least 15 people and cutting electricity to hundreds of thousands of households, according to Ukrainian officials.

Russia’s Defense Ministry said its forces intercepted 644 Ukrainian drones. Airport restrictions delayed more than 200 flights from four Moscow airports; 46 flights were delayed or canceled in St. Petersburg.

candidates.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged supporters of Ukraine to defend a new U.S. sanctions package targeting Russia after President Donald Trump put the restrictions on hold. Zelenskyy said blocking the package would encourage further Russian attacks and thanked the Democratic and Republican lawmakers who backed it.
candidates.title: Zelenskyy urges support for paused US sanctions on Russia

candidates.summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar said Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy was unlikely to visit Budapest later in October. A Zelenskyy aide had said Ukraine's leader was invited to join events on October 23 commemorating the 70th anniversary of the Hungarian Revolution.
candidates.title: Hungarian prime minister says Zelenskyy visit is unlikely
